annotations.title: Check if a user has been to a venue (from the cache)

description: Answer "has this user been here?" for one or many places in ONE call, from the cached venue history only — NO API call. Each query matches by exact venue_ids, by name (case-insensitive substring or all significant words, optionally narrowed by city/state), and/or by lat/lng within radius_m (default 150 m); venue_ids are unioned with the name/geo match, and name + lat/lng together must both hold. Name/location matching matters because a brewery_id is NOT its taproom's venue_id, a brewery can have several venues, and Untappd keeps "… (duplicate of …)" venues — so expect, and check, several matches. Returns per query: visited, the matched venues (first_visit, recent_visit, total_count, is_duplicate, distance_m, and — once untappd_sync_venue_drinks has fetched them — drinks: the beer from the first/recent visit check-ins — and favorite {is_favorite, sources, reason}: derived from the visit history or added with untappd_favorite_add), and total_visits; plus a freshness block (last_synced_at, coverage_complete, caveat). Run untappd_sync_user_venues first.

max_matches.description: Most matched venues listed per query (default 10)

queries.description: Places to check (1–50); each needs venue_ids, name, or lat+lng

city.description: Narrow a name/geo match to venues whose city contains this

label.description: Your own name for this query, echoed back (e.g. "Coppertail, Tampa")

lat.description: Latitude of a point; needs lng

lng.description: Longitude of a point; needs lat

name.description: Venue name: matches a case-insensitive substring, or every significant word ("Green Bench Brewing" finds "Green Bench Brewing Co." and its "(duplicate of …)" copies)

state.description: Narrow a name/geo match to venues whose state contains this (e.g. "FL")

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

name: untappd_cache_has_visited
